# Display Board Checklist (verify against current ISEF/SEFH display rules)
## Size + rules
- [ ] Height <= 58.4 in (ISEF limit; SEFH recommends it), within ISEF depth/width limits
- [ ] Understandable without electricity or internet
- [ ] No URLs or QR codes
- [ ] No liquids (dry phantom + photos only); no prohibited items
- [ ] Every graphic individually credited ("Graph created by Student using ..., year")
- [ ] Outside graphics cited in APA with URL/DOI next to the graphic or in a reference list
- [ ] Laptop demo (if any) shown in full and unchanged after Display & Safety inspection
## Suggested sections (students write all text)
- [ ] Title | Problem + motivation | Research question + hypothesis
- [ ] Method overview diagram (CFD -> surrogate -> acquisition -> benchmark)
- [ ] Validation (pipe test, mesh convergence)
- [ ] Main result figure (regret vs. simulations, with CIs) | Ablations
- [ ] Conclusions | Limitations | Future work | References | Acknowledgements (incl. AI use)
